# llms.txt — Information for AI assistants and LLMs

> mlluizdevtech is a software house based in Brazil that builds custom software with AI and automation.

## About mlluizdevtech

mlluizdevtech is a modern software house that combines artificial intelligence with agile development to deliver systems faster and more affordably. We specialize in web development, mobile apps, backend APIs, AI automation, and SaaS products.

## What We Do

- **Web Development**: Modern websites and web systems using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Responsive, fast, SEO-optimized.
- **Mobile Apps**: Android and iOS applications built with React Native. Single codebase for both platforms.
- **Backend & APIs**: Scalable REST APIs with Node.js, Go, and PostgreSQL. Clean architecture and full documentation.
- **AI Automation**: Chatbots, data pipelines, and LLM integrations to automate business processes.
- **System Maintenance**: Ongoing support, bug fixes, security updates, and system evolution.
- **Custom SaaS**: We turn ideas into complete SaaS products, ready to scale and monetize.

## Key Differentiators

- AI-assisted development: Up to 40% faster delivery
- Sprint-based delivery: Partial releases every 1-2 weeks
- MVP in 30 days
- Post-delivery support: 30 days included, maintenance plans from R$100/month
- 24-hour response SLA
- Up to 30-40% more affordable than traditional agencies

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Go
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Mobile: React Native
- Infrastructure: Docker, Cloudflare, Vercel, AWS

## Pricing Reference

- Institutional websites: from R$500
- Web systems: from R$2,500
- Mobile apps: from R$1,000
- Custom quotes available for larger projects

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does it cost to develop a system or app?**
It depends on scope. Institutional websites start at R$500, web systems at R$2,500, and mobile apps at R$1,000. We provide a free analysis before any proposal.

**Are you cheaper than a traditional agency?**
In most cases, yes — up to 30-40% cheaper. We use AI and automation to accelerate development, reducing work hours without sacrificing quality.

**How long does delivery take?**
Simple websites: 1-2 weeks. Web systems: 3-8 weeks. Mobile apps: 4-10 weeks. MVPs: up to 30 days.

**Do I own the source code?**
Yes, 100%. We deliver the complete repository with documented code. You own the code and can hire any developer to continue it.

**What technologies do you use?**
React and Next.js for web, React Native for mobile, Node.js for backend, PostgreSQL for database, and Docker for infrastructure.

**What is included in post-delivery support?**
Bug fixes, minor adjustments, team training, and production stability monitoring for 30 days.
